newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Santos says oil price above its budget.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Santos says oil price above its budget.

text.p: Oil and gas producer Santos Ltd said on Wednesday that despite a recent fall in crude oil prices, the market was still above the price the company budgeted for this year.
"It's above our budget at the moment," Santos managing director Ross Adler told reporters.
Earlier, the company said it expected its calendar 1997 earnings after tax to be comparable with its 1996 result, barring any major change in oil prices, exchange rates and interest rates.
Santos' share price came under pressure last month and early this month after a slide in oil prices.
Santos earlier on Wednesday reported a 40 percent rise in 1996 net earnings to A$195.9 million, and partly attributed the result to higher oil prices compared with 1995.
March Tapis crude was trading at US$22.30 a barrel on Wednesday.
"Anything above US$20 we think is a good oil price going back over the last six or seven years, and certainly the current price is above our budget average for the year," Adler said.
"So it's certainly not a wipe-out and we think there's general momentum in oil prices."
Santos shares ended four cents lower at A$4.94 on Wednesday.
